 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Los Angeles Clippers look to start a win streak when they travel to face the Phoenix Suns on Tuesday. The game begins at 9 PM ET and will air on ClipperVision, Suns+, and AZFamily.
 The Clippers are coming off a 139-123 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans, which snapped a seven-game losing streak. They are now 2-7 on the season, putting them 13th in the West. This is their lone road game in a stretch where they are playing six of seven at home.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Suns are on a back-to-back, losing to the San Antonio Spurs, 122-96 on Monday night. The loss snapped a two-game win streak. They are 3-6 on the season, 12th in the West. This is their fifth game on a seven-game homestand.
 This will be the first of four meetings between the two teams.
 Los Angeles Clippers Injury Report
 Brandon Ingram is OUT after undergoing right heel surgery. He has yet to play this season, but appears close to a return. There is no official timetable for when he will make his Clippers debut.
 Bradley Beal is OUT with right knee injury management. It is unclear when he will return to the court after playing in only six games last year before undergoing hip surgery.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Cam Christie is QUESTIONABLE with a right ankle sprain. In five games this season, he is averaging six minutes off the bench.
 Jordan Miller is OUT after undergoing left rotator cuff surgery. On August 26, it was reported that he would be reevaluated in six months.
 Kirby Lee-Imagn Images
 Yanic Konan Niederhauser is OUT after undergoing right Lisfranc surgery. He underwent surgery in March, and there is no timetable for his return.
 Nick Martinelli is QUESTIONABLE on a G League two-way deal.
 The Clippers started Darius Garland , Derrick Jones Jr., Brook Lopez, Rui Hachimura, and Kris Dunn against the Pelicans.
 Kobe Sanders, Baba Miller, Max Strus, Keaton Wagler, and Gradey Dick all played more than 16 minutes. With Isaiah Jackson not in the lineup, Miller played nearly 20 minutes. Jackson will be back in the lineup on Tuesday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Clippers are 19th in offense and 22nd in defense.
 Phoenix Suns Injury Report
 Mark Williams is OUT after undergoing left labrum surgery in September. There is no timetable for his return.
 The Suns started Devin Booker, Dillon Brooks, Miles Bridges, Jalen Green, and Oso Ighodaro against the Spurs. Collin Gillespie, Ryan Dunn, Khaman Maluach, and Luke Kennard all played 14 minutes or more off the bench.
 Jordan Goodwin will return to the lineup after missing Monday's game.
 The Suns are 23rd in offense and 27th in defense.
